_what: Local Housing Allowance rates — the ceiling on the Universal Credit housing element for a PRIVATE rented tenancy, by Broad Rental Market Area.
_why_monthly: These are the UNIVERSAL CREDIT monthly figures, not the weekly Housing Benefit ones. UC assessment periods are monthly and the statements quote monthly, so mixing in a weekly rate would be wrong by a factor of about 4.33 while still looking like a plausible rent.
_frozen: Rates from 1 April 2026 were set by The Rent Officers (Housing Benefit and Universal Credit Functions) (Modification) Order 2026 (SI 2026/5) and are the SAME rates that came into force on 1 April 2024. LHA has been frozen at 2024/25 levels for 2025/26 and 2026/27. That is why the observed Bournemouth element does not move across two years of statements — it is a policy freeze, not a stale figure.
_residue: Only the two BRMAs relevant to this record were taken from the CSV. England alone has around 150 more, and Scotland and Wales are separate files. A BRMA that is not listed here is NOT looked up and must not be guessed — add it from the source above.
_categories: SAR is the Shared Accommodation Rate. Which category applies to a single person depends on age and on exemptions, which are NOT recorded here because they are facts about the claimant rather than about the area.
